title: prospectivity-apac-buyer-friction-and-quant-bench
creator: Priya Rao
description: Objective: Produce an evidence-driven synthesis that quantifies buyer friction and model fallback economics for APAC enterprise prospects, combining qualitative interviews with lightweight synthetic microbenchmarks. Background: Multiple sales lost to latency and inference cost concerns in APAC. We need a defensible playbook linking model choices, quantization strategies, and regional infra options to commercial outcomes (SLA thresholds, pricing sensitivity, acceptable quality degradation). Scope: (1) 12 targeted buyer interviews across APAC verticals (finserv, e-commerce, healthcare), (2) 3 synthetic workload microbench experiments across representative RAG patterns, short-context chat, and long-form generation, (3) competitor gap map for 6 leading model providers with regional availability annotations, (4) economics simulator linking tokens/sec, latency percentiles, and projected monthly spend. Deliverables: interview readout, quant-bench workbook (CSV + summary), competitive gap map graphic, decision canvas with recommended routing/fallback heuristics for sales/SEs.
tasks: Define synthetic workload corpus and metrics (throughput, p95 latency, token cost) (Eng SME)
Run microbench on hosted samples in APAC regions (Eng ops)
Aggregate competitor availability and SLA claims (market intel)
Synthesize findings and create playbook for field (PM)
acceptance_criteria: 12 completed interviews with transcribed notes and top-3 pain points per prospect
Microbench csv with repeatable runs and p50/p95 latency for each workload
Competitive gap map with regional availability and quantization support annotated
Econ simulator that projects monthly cost for 3 customer archetypes and includes sensitivity to batch size and quantization level
Executive one-pager and a 12-slide deck for GTM and sales enablement
activity_log: 2025-02-15: Kickoff meeting with Eng, Sales, and Field Research. Agreed scope and customer cohorts.
2025-02-18: Draft interview screener v1 shared (link in artifacts).
2025-02-20: Eng SME provided synthetic corpus and initial runner config (short-chat, rag-ctx-8k, long-form-2k).
2025-02-24: First two interviews completed (APAC fintech + e-comm); early latency complaint pattern emerging.
2025-02-28: Microbench runs scheduled in ap-southeast-1 and ap-northeast-1; Eng ops to capture kernel/quantization flags.
2025-03-03: Interim synthesis: buyers accept ~150-200ms p95 for interactive features, long-form tolerant to 500ms p95; quantization has 10-18% quality delta on ranking tasks.
notes: Trade-offs: deeper microbench on every model would improve fidelity but delay field playbook; we prioritize representative families (open quantized, vendor M, vendor L).
Risk: interview sample biased to Tier-1 prospects; mitigate with two mid-market calls next week.

Preliminary recommendation: prioritize latency-first routing for interactive features in APAC with fallback to lower-cost quantized variants only when quality degradation < 12% as measured on domain evals.
Next steps: finalize econ simulator knobs and hand off to Sales Enablement for playbook testing by 2025-03-25.
